waddle_dee.description: Small, round red creature with a pale face, big eyes, and orange feet that walks peacefully - waddle dee

waddle_doo.description: Round red creature with a single giant eye and two small spikes that fires beam attacks - waddle doo

bronto_burt.description: Pink, spherical winged creature with small feet that flies in swooping or hovering patterns - bronto burt

hot_head.description: Flaming red creature that shoots small fireballs or breathes continuous fire - hot head

sparky.description: Small, blue, oval creature with a lightbulb-like top that emits electrical charges - sparky

poppy_bros_jr.description: Small creature wearing a blue pointed hat that hops around and tosses bombs - poppy bros jr

sir_kibble.description: Creature encased in yellow armor wearing a cutter helmet that throws boomerang blades - sir kibble

maxim_tomato.description: Bright red tomato item marked with a prominent letter M that restores full health - maxim tomato

candy_powerup.description: Wrapped striped candy item that grants temporary invincibility - candy powerup
